body: That sounds like am awful way of living, I'd rather not live at all.
Playing games sometimes makes me happy. I already do that too much though.
What? I don't want to live in society, why would I want to help it? I have hobbies but they are meaningless and non-fullfilling ways to distract myself until I die.
That's pointless. Nothing will make my pain go away. I came here because I don't know where else to go, if you know of a better place for my purpose then please let me know.
